source_prior: zero mean, isotropic coefficient precision 0.25, Gaussian linear posterior on the existing six-feature basis
target_allocation: uniform node-index order: four per node plus quotient/remainder allocation of the remaining 80 observations; identical acquired prefixes for all policies
candidate: full-target-data Bayesian model average of source-warm and scratch posterior means, weighted by their Gaussian marginal likelihoods and prior probability 0.1 for the scratch/change component; no early nomination or threshold
score: independent 1024-point target test-design MSE grouped by changed and unchanged nodes; evaluator-only labels and latent coefficients
gate: For every source-size and family-change k stratum, candidate changed-node mean MSE <=1.05 times scratch and untouched-node mean MSE <=1.05 times source-warm. For coefficient changes, candidate changed-node mean MSE <=1.05 times the better of scratch and source-warm, with the same untouched condition. Report per-seed means and paired uncertainty; passing is only a basis for a broader misspecification and scale study, not a paper claim.
custody: source acquisitions counted once per source-size/system, reused across six target settings; exact 200 target responses per setting; source posterior, action/metric, protocol, and source revision hashes; deterministic replay
forbidden: No changed labels, latent coefficients, target test responses, private outcomes, Azure, or any other closed-source model output enter the candidate or controls. No rule changes after generating these systems.
